items.hyp: Ab'ekitongole ekirala ekyo bagamba nti ekitongole ky'okukola kino kikolebwa ku "Yes We Can" ekikulu kya Barak Obama ekikola kampeyini.

items.hyp: Ekitongole ekyo ekyo ky'okukola mu bitundu by'emyaka 20 mu disitulikiti y'e Gulu kyatandika nga Jjuuni 25 ne kiteerezebwa nga Jjulaayi 25.
items.ref: Pulojekiti egenda okukolebwa mu magombolola agasukka amakumi abiri mu disitulikiti y'e Gulu yatandika nga abiri mu ttaano Ogwomukaaga era ya kukomekkerezebwa ng'abiri mu ttaano Ogwomusanvu.

items.hyp: Abantu bangi mu kitundu kya Gulu abo abalina ekyo kye balina kye balina.
items.ref: Abantu b'omu bitundu by'e Gulu pulojekiti gyeeri mu kukolebwa kati basanyufu nnyo.

items.hyp: Baagamba nti abo abalala baali bamu ku bikwata ku UPDF.
items.ref: Baanokolayo nti abamu ku bannaabwe baayingizibwa eggye lya Uganda People's Deforce Force.

items.hyp: Abantu abalala baali bawangula mu bitongole by'okwerinda era batandika okukola enkola yaabwe era batandika okukola enkola yaabwe ku Bannasisira.
items.ref: Abalala baalina ebitongole by'ebyokwerinda bye baalinako akakwate ebyabayambanga okulondoola n'okumanyisa Abasiraamu.

items.hyp: Abasirikale ba ADF kakooza Ahmad ne Dada Mukibi baasalawo okukola ssente.
items.ref: Bammemba ba Allied Democratic Forces babiri, Kakooza Ahmad ne Dada Mukibi bammiddwa looni.

items.hyp: Ofiisi ya ADF e Kitante ekyo kyali kikulu mu kuyamba abantu okukola abantu abeekalakasa.
items.ref: Woofiisi ekola ku kunoonyereza n'okulondoola e Kitante eyali ekola ku kutabaganya enkola za ADF yali tekyakola.

items.hyp: Mu kiseera kino okukola gavumenti, abantu bonna baali bawangulwa abali mu ADF abali mu bukiikakkono.
items.ref: Mu kukola ne Gavumenti, obulamu bwabwe bubadde bwongedde okuteekebwa mu katyabaga okuva eri bannaabwe ba Allied Democratic Forces abakyali mu nsiko.

items.hyp: Baagamba nti baali baakubira abo abalala lyonna nga Lyavaala, Zilyawulawo, Junju, Kasakya, Issa Twatera, Benon Musisi, Kagimu.
items.ref: Baayogera ku kufa kw'ekibwatukira okwa bannaabwe nga Lyavaale, Zilyawulawo, Junju, Kasakya, Issa Twatera, Benon Musisi, Kagimu.

items.hyp: Abawagizi b'abo abalala baali baddewo era abo abali mu ggye lya ADF baagamba nti baali baddewo okulwanyisa obutujju.
items.ref: Abamu ku bannaabwe battibwa mu ngeri etaategeerekeka era abamu ku baaliko abayeekera ba Allied Democratic Forces baatiisatiisa okuttukiza ebikolwa y'obutujju.

items.hyp: Mu Okitobba 2008 abakungu ba bannabyabufuzi baali beemulugunya okwongera okwaliwo abo abava mu ADF ababulira gavumenti okukozesa.
items.ref: Mu Gwekkumi gwa 2008, abakulira ebitongole by'ebyokwerinda baasisinkana okukubaganya ebirowoozo ku nsonga y'abaliko abayeekera ba ADF balumiriza gavumenti okubakozesa.

items.hyp: Abayeekera ba ADF abalala baagamba gavumenti nti baagala okukola n'okukola abo ne bagenda mu kifo ky'okukuba abantu.
items.ref: Abaaliko abayeekera ba Allied Democratic Forces baalumizizza gavumenti okubakozesa n'ebasuulawo nga tebasasudde.

items.hyp: Ebikwekweto eby'obubudamo ebyaliwo mu Kampala nga Jjulaayi 11 ebyali byatandika okulaga nti byali by'ekitongole kya ADF ne Al-Shabaab ekya Somalia ekikola ku nsonga y'abatujju.
items.ref: Obulumbanyi bwa bbomu obwali mu Kampala nga 11 Ogwomusanvu bwava ku nkolagana wakati wa ADF ne bamukwatammundu Abasiraamu aba Al-Shabaab abasangibwa e Somalia.

items.hyp: Olw'okuba abantu abalina obulamu obw'okuba abalina obulimu okugenda mu kufuna obulamu, abo abaali baagala okukola aba ADF baagala okukola abaali mu kufuna obulimu.
items.ref: Olw'embeera enzibu era ey'okwennyamira gye bawangaaliramu, bannamawulire ba Allied Democratic Forces abatamanyi kiddako baddiziddwa mu bikolwa by'obutujju.

items.hyp: Abdusalam Lukwebe Mwebe ne bannaabwe abalala baali mu ku abo abeesimbyewo aba ADF.
items.ref: Abdusalam Lukwebe Mwebe n'abalala be bamu ku baali bammemba ba Allied Democratic Forces.

items.hyp: Olupapula lwa Independent olwa Jjulaayi 2010 lwafulumizibwa nti abakulu ba ADF tebaagala okukola obuyinza naye abasajja baabwe baali baddayo nga bwe baali baddayo mu gavumenti.
items.ref: Independent w'Ogomusanvu, 2010, yawandiika nti abooluganda b'abaaliko mmemba wa ADF tebafuna buyambi kyokka ng'abaami baabwe baafiira ku mirimu gya Gavumenti.

items.hyp: Ekitongole kya Kampala City Council Authority kisobola okukola abantu ab'omu Kampala okukola obuyinza.
items.ref: Kampala City Council Authority lubeerera ekubiriza bannakampala okuba abayonjo.

items.hyp: Okusinziira ku kunoonyereza kino, abawagizi b'omu ku abo abalala nga Rwigyema Shafik ne Tumusiime Hassan be bamu ku bulumbaganyi.
items.ref: Ekino kiviiriddemu bannaabwe nga Rwigyema Shafik ne Tumusiime Hassan ebuzibu.
